summary: Per-frame accumulator update gated on a mode word at offset 0x78: mode 0 disables the update, mode 1 resets the accumulator dword at offset 0x84 to 0, and any other non-zero mode adds argument a2 to the accumulator float at offset 0x84. After the update the accumulator value at offset 0x84 is forwarded to sub_4A2840. Invoked from ConditionalDispatch_55a0.

operations.description: Reads the mode word at offset 0x78; when it is 0 the function returns without touching the accumulator or calling sub_4A2840
When the mode word at offset 0x78 is exactly 1 the accumulator at offset 0x84 is reset instead of being incremented
In mode 1 the accumulator dword at offset 0x84 is set to 0
For any other non-zero mode the accumulator float at offset 0x84 is set to argument a2 plus its previous value
After the accumulator update, sub_4A2840 is invoked with this object and the accumulator value at offset 0x84 for further processing

unresolved: The identity of the object owning offsets 0x78 and 0x84 is unknown
The meaning of the mode values at offset 0x78 (beyond 0=disabled and 1=reset) is not documented
sub_4A2840's behavior and the significance of the forwarded accumulator value are outside this packet
